verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an email-marketing SaaS like MailerLite, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency, or data-center location. The items cover only the API, SDKs, MCP, CLI, webhooks, editors and other marketing features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
